hints.title: Palindromic Equivalence
hints.text: A string is identical to its reverse if and only if it forms a palindrome.

hints.title: Symmetric Character Comparison
hints.text: Compare each character at index i with its mirrored counterpart at index n - 1 - i.

hints.title: Single Flip per Mismatch
hints.text: Each mismatched pair requires exactly one character flip to make both positions match.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: N: length of binary string s
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all flipped variants requires exponential time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identify palindrome property and count symmetric mismatches.
